1.2.3.2-f16.accuracy_reason: The unguentum armarium was the weapon-salve, applied to the weapon and supposed to heal by sympathy. This was the subject of the Goclenius and Libavius dispute.

1.2.3.2-f9.accuracy_reason: Paracelsus does describe imagination as a star or astrum working within a man, and Burton names Paracelsus just before.
